content.what_it_is: Python (numpy/matplotlib) workshop script plotting FUNWAVE-TVD eta snapshots for the inlet_shoal case. Sets fdir to a hard-coded workshop output path (L10, comments L8-L9 instruct users to substitute their own path) and loads dep_shoal_inlet.txt from a second hard-coded path (L12). Grid: n,m from np.shape (L16), dx=dy=2.0 (L17-L18), x,y arrays by list comprehension (L20-L21). Sponge outline x 0-180 (L24-L25) and wavemaker outline x 240-260 (L27-L28) using y[len(y)-1]. Snapshot list nfile=[5, 11] (L31) with time labels min=['150','900'] (L32). Creates a 10x5 inch dpi=200 figure (L35-L36, L40). Loop (L42-L69): zero-padded fnum (L43), loads eta_ and mask_ from fdir (L44-L45), masks with np.ma.masked_where(mask==0,eta) (L47), subplot 1xN (L49), pcolor with cmap='coolwarm' (L51), tight axis (L52), title 'Time = <min> sec' (L53-L54), plt.hold(True) (L55), sponge green dashed with green rotated text (L58-L59), wavemaker black with black rotated text (L60-L61); first panel gets ylabel+xlabel (L63-L65), subsequent panels get xlabel plus a colorbar labeled eta (m) (L66-L69). Saves inlet__shoal_wave.png (L72).
entities: min time-label list L32 (shadows builtin min)
